training_control.meaning: The mapped persistent boxer training attributes did not change during the title-fight/progression transition.

calendar_observation.note: The visible career calendar advanced 39 weeks across a contract that displayed 12 weeks until fight. This is a strong reason not to model the displayed lead-time value as a direct real-calendar delta without recovering the career calendar/training advancement logic.

overhaul_implications: Winning the observed amateur title does not immediately convert the player to professional status in the captured state: Jacob remains AMATEUR MIDDLEWEIGHT and UNRANKED at 10-0-0, 9 KO.

The rival can independently transition to the professional division while remaining the player's named rival. That is direct retail precedent for independently simulated NPC career progression in the planned overhaul.
A separate Amateur Championship Package unlock exists in the Fight Store after the title-fight milestone, extending the already-proven retail milestone/unlock infrastructure.

The post-title checkpoint introduces several new persistent career-state candidates, but none should be called the champion flag until isolated by another title/progression transition or writer trace.
next_capture: Dismiss the current notification sequence one message at a time and screenshot every additional popup before taking any training or contract action.

At the first stable Career Central screen, open Sign Contract and screenshot the top EARNINGS/BANK line. If EARNINGS displays $0, that strongly resolves 0x08D98568 as a current-year/current-cycle earnings field rather than bank.
Open the Fight Store and capture the Amateur Championship Package description, price, requirements, and effect.

If the Championship Package costs money and purchasing it is acceptable, checkpoint 14 is already a clean pre-purchase baseline: buy it and immediately create one post-purchase savestate before any other action. That experiment can separate bank from the cumulative-money candidate at 0x08D98578 and expose ownership/activation state.
Do not sign another contract or train until the notification queue and Fight Store/earnings evidence have been documented.
